transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for being here. As Festival Director, I've called this finalization meeting to review the confirmed production requirements for the 'Tide Memory' installation before I sign off on the final exhibition and opening-night package. We need reports from each of you on your respective areas — technical operations, rights compliance, accessibility setup, and creator appearance. Please go ahead and share your confirmed requirements so we can finalize everything today.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share my technical findings from yesterday's systems check. My equipment test showed that the installation can run reliably on exactly six stations, not eight. Additionally, each headset requires a five-minute sanitation reset after a 15-minute viewing, which means each timed session needs to be exactly 20 minutes. I recorded this in the technical worksheet, but it hasn't been attached to the festival master brief yet. These are confirmed technical operations requirements that should be reflected in the final package.

I confirmed with the distributor this morning — the festival license for 'Tide Memory' permits exactly three public showings, and it prohibits visitor recording. I received the countersigned license addendum this morning, but these limits have not yet been entered in the event contract summary. This means the current draft plan's allowance of unrestricted visitor recording is not permitted, and the number of public showings must be capped at three.
